#: Pointing at overlays with the controllers (run.py --cases laser-mouse --script scripts/laser.json --ini ini/laser_mouse.ini --expect expect/laser_mouse.json; the same under ini/laser_mouse_steamvr.ini; the key is laserMouse). The right laser on the overlay's centre gets it the focus and a MouseMove, its trigger a MouseButtonDown and Up (Left, from the right controller, device 2), at (100, 50) of its 200 x 100 mouse units (from its lower left); while it's on it, it's the hover target and laser haptics pulse that hand. A 2 cm cursor quad is drawn on it, and no frame call comes out of order.
